product_one_liner.value: Bitly helps businesses and marketers create, share, manage, and track short links and QR codes to measure audience engagement across online and offline channels.

eng_blog.notes: Engineer-authored posts cover Go backend infrastructure and the Trust & Safety Engineering Team’s abuse-detection architecture.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page exists, but its six-position section does not expose the full role list in readable form. Only Director, Website Strategy could be verified live; older AI/ML postings are closed, so a reliable yes/no could not be established.

model_provider.notes: No underlying model provider was disclosed in the reviewed Bitly Assist documentation, AI FAQs, blog, or accessible security/subprocessor materials. ChatGPT and Claude compatibility establishes integrations, not the model powering Bitly Assist.

compliance_certs.notes: These are the requested compliance claims publicly listed; GDPR is a regulatory compliance claim, not an independent certification.

last_funding.notes: Spectrum Equity’s majority investment was announced July 12, 2017.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest documented funding predates the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A careers page and live Director, Website Strategy posting exist, but the full six-position list was not readable. Located account-executive and SDR postings were closed; current SDR/BDR/AE hiring could not be established.

launched_6mo.notes: On October 20, 2026, Bitly announced its ChatGPT plugin for link and QR-code creation and performance analysis, within the May 9–November 9, 2026 window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Bitly announced Matt Young’s appointment as Chief Technology Officer on March 19, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Historical SDR job requirements name these sales systems; this is a historical stack signal, not confirmation of current deployment.
